Source/scope information: libz-sys 1.1.30

Current arm64 build output links system libz (-lz), not a bundled archive. Stock zlib notice is included conservatively for the upstream fallback. zlib-ng features are not enabled. This entry covers this Rust wrapper and its stock zlib path, not unrelated optional contrib utilities.
